row.title: What Works went live; repo creation and visibility still needed the owner
row.body: What Works is live at what-works.ultrastable.org (deploy 2026-11-25 15:42 UTC, custom domain attached although deploy-ultrastable reports ultrastable.org routes unreadable). Two steps needed Rowan: creating ultrastable/what-works and making it public, because tenant-repos.yml has none of its three credential routes bound (same gap as tenant-repo-unlearn). Tenant repos must be public: seedlife and deploy read them over raw.githubusercontent.com. This change adds What Works to progress, stickiness, the showcase and the social queue (TENANT-PROMO-1).
